en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a large modernist stone-and-concrete building on a hillside surrounded by trees, with people standing along the terrace; in the foreground there is a railing and part of a stepped structure. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Pécs and mentions a holiday resort in the Mecsek mountains. The reverse side has handwritten text in blue ink, Hungarian postage stamps, and an address in Budapest.
